topic: Pick a hiking trail for Saturday

scenario.topic: Pick a hiking trail for Saturday
scenario.opening_question: What matters most to you for Saturday's hike—scenic views, trail difficulty, distance, or how close the trailhead is?

options.name: Eagle Ridge Loop Trail
options.upside: Offers panoramic mountain views and a well-maintained path.
options.tradeoff: Longer drive to the trailhead compared to other options.
options.concern: Moderate elevation gain might be tiring if the weather is warm.
options.best_for: Prioritizing scenic vistas and moderate challenge.

options.name: Silver Creek Waterfall Trail
options.upside: Shorter hike with a rewarding waterfall destination.
options.tradeoff: Less challenging and fewer panoramic views.
options.concern: Trail can be muddy and slippery near the waterfall after rain.
options.best_for: A shorter, easier hike with a specific natural highlight.

options.name: Pine Valley Ridge Trail
options.upside: Challenging hike with diverse terrain and forested sections.
options.tradeoff: Longest and most strenuous option, may take up most of the day.
options.concern: Requires good fitness and early start to finish comfortably.
options.best_for: Those wanting a full workout and varied natural scenery.

options.name: Lakeside Meadow Trail
options.upside: Easy trail with a peaceful lakeside picnic area.
options.tradeoff: Less elevation and fewer dramatic views, mostly flat terrain.
options.concern: Can be crowded on weekends due to easy access.
options.best_for: Relaxed hiking with scenic water views and minimal effort.

shared_context: There are exactly 2 participants planning the hike together.
The hike is planned for Saturday, starting mid-morning around 10 AM.
Both participants want to finish the hike by late afternoon to have time for dinner plans.

personas.name: Vince
personas.background: Prefers shorter hikes with specific natural highlights because he enjoys a balance of activity and relaxation on weekends.
personas.private_goal: To pick a trail that offers a rewarding destination without requiring a long drive or excessive exertion.

personas.name: Lila
personas.background: Has a strong preference for challenging physical activities and wants to feel accomplished after the hike.
personas.private_goal: To choose a trail that provides a full workout and varied terrain, even if it requires an early start and more effort.
personas.rejection_reason: Eagle Ridge's moderate elevation gain and longer drive do not meet Lila's desire for a strenuous and varied hike.
